yt_description:
Ever seen data do a little dance? 🕺 Meet Cocktail Sort, also known as Bidirectional Bubble Sort! We're diving deep into how this quirky algorithm sorts arrays by moving elements back and forth like a bartender shaking a cocktail. 🍸 Watch as we visualize its surprisingly elegant (and sometimes inefficient!) process. Perfect for coders, computer science students, and anyone who loves a good sorting algorithm! ✨
